item.title: [+1] Commerce minister says lower US tariffs than rival nations are 'already agreed' for Indian goods
item.description:
He said Indian goods will get preferential access to the US market. It follows the foreign minister saying the deal is in its final stage. Ongoing; no signing date yet.

Pharma & healthcare: mild tailwind (+1) — US access

Why it matters: Confirmed preferential tariffs would help textiles, engineering and pharma exporters take US market share from Asian rivals.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
